literature_method_source.native_metric: Jeffries-Matusita distance and integrated population distance
literature_method_source.baseline_normalization: single-cell ERK/EKAR trajectories normalized to each cell's pre-stimulation baseline mean
literature_method_source.role: published native experimental metric; not a SymC metric

permitted_operations: read only the first logical CSV header row from each allowed CSV or CSV.GZ member
record member size/hash for allowed members
map published method-required fields to source columns if explicit
forbidden_operations: select subsets based on observed outcomes
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
pass_rule: published native metric inputs can be mapped from README/header metadata without reading data rows or inventing a new observable
stop_rule: if required native inputs cannot be mapped without choosing among materially different representations, stop for scientific decision
